s2.ptxt: Install the rear wiper rubber to the rear wiper rubber backing plate as shown in the illustration.

atten3.ptxt: Make sure the curvature of the rear wiper rubber backing plate faces the same direction as the curvature of the back door glass.

s2.ptxt: Insert the rear wiper rubber from the 2th claw from the tip of the rear wiper blade toward the rear end.
After passing the rear wiper rubber through the claws on the rear end side, let it protrude past the stopper on the rear end side, then pass it through the claws on the tip side.
Check that the claws of the rear wiper blade are in the grooves of the rear wiper rubber.

item.ptxt: If the claws of the rear wiper blade are not in the grooves of the rear wiper rubber, pinch the rear wiper rubber and slide it several times to fit it into the grooves.
Applying a small amount of window washer fluid to the rear wiper rubber makes it easier to fit into the grooves.

atten3.ptxt: Do not force the rear wiper rubber to slide, as this may deform the rear wiper rubber backing plate and damage the claws of the rear wiper blade.

s2.ptxt: Engage the claw and install the rear wiper blade.
